```python
def get_height_and_balance(node):
    if not node:
        return 0, True
    left_height, left_balanced = get_height_and_balance(node.left)
    right_height, right_balanced = get_height_and_balance(node.right)
    balanced = left_balanced and right_balanced and abs(left_height - right_height) <= 1
    return 1 + max(left_height, right_height), balanced

def is_tree_balanced(root):
    def get_height_and_balance(node):
        if not node:
            return 0, True
        left_height, left_balanced = get_height_and_balance(node.left)
        right_height, right_balanced = get_height_and_balance(node.right)
        height = max(left_height, right_height) + 1
        balanced = left_balanced and right_balanced and abs(left_height - right_height) <= 1
        return height, balanced

    _, balanced = get_height_and_balance(root)
    return balanced
